title: Oh Baby a Triple
blurb: "Oh baby, a triple!" A man in an old Wii bowling advert hollers this with enthusiasm that exceeds the situation by several orders of magnitude. The internet extracted the line, looped it, and installed it as the standard reaction to three of anything at all. Nothing gets purer than that as a meme: a stranger's completely genuine excitement, permanently detached from whatever caused it. Deploy it whenever something happens for the third time, however trivial the third time turns out to be. Three biscuits qualifies. So does a third email from the same person.
origin: A line from a Nintendo Wii bowling advert, extracted into meme use.
